overview: Finalize the simulation loop by implementing deterministic state hashing for save/load integrity, optimizing the tick scheduler for zero-allocation execution, and integrating the final psychological state machine for colonist ascension. This batch closes the remaining coverage gaps in the core simulation loop, ensuring 100% deterministic reproducibility and minimal memory footprint for the endgame state.

tasks.title: Implement Zero-Allocation Deterministic State Hasher
acceptance_criteria: Hasher produces identical uint64_t for identical state sequences across 1000 runs.
Zero heap allocations during hashing phase.
Compiled with -O2, no dynamic memory usage in profiler.
tasks.player_fun_impact: Instant save/load verification, no lag on resume.

tasks.title: Optimize Tick Scheduler with Fixed-Size Ring Buffer
acceptance_criteria: Scheduler handles 10,000 events per tick without reallocation.
No null pointer dereferences in stress test.
tasks.player_fun_impact: Smooth 60fps simulation even with complex physics interactions.

tasks.title: Finalize Colonist Ascension State Machine
acceptance_criteria: All 16,500 footsteps logged correctly map to states.
No undefined behavior in state transitions.
tasks.player_fun_impact: Clear visual feedback on colonist progress.
